name: Earth
about: The default theme. A theme renames and redraws the game without changing its rules. Each table maps the Rust name of a variant (UnitType, Building, Tech, Terrain, Resource, Government, Faith) to the name shown; leave an entry out to keep the Earth name. 'effects' rewrites what a building does, as the city panel shows it. 'calendar' writes years: {year} is replaced. 'terms' are proper nouns: game_title, destination (the space race's star), barbarian (the raiders' adjective). 'sprites' is the folder under assets/ holding this theme's sprite sheets.
